name: genpark-agentic-price-drop-refund-arbiter-skill
description: Autonomous Post-Purchase Price Drop Monitor & Retailer Refund Claim Arbiter. Tracks online purchases across Shopify, Walmart, Best Buy, and Target, detects price drops within the merchant price-match guarantee window, verifies eligibility conditions, and synthesizes automated refund claims.
